title: Works Well
text: Works Well. My husband recently gave our coffee grinder to our daughter to use at college. He really hated to part with his because he uses it regularly. So I ordered this one to replace his. This one is actually a little better than the one he had. He doesn't use the grinder for coffee beans, he has a coffee burr for that. He uses his grinder for spices. He likes to make his own rubs for meat before he cooks them on the smoker. This one has a storage container for your ground up stuff. It also has different speeds for the grinding, too. It does what he needs it to do, so he is satisfied.

product_metadata.title: Coffee Grinder Electric, HOMEASY Electric Spice Grinder Coffee Bean Grinder Spice Blender for Coffee Bean Nuts Spice with 304 Stainless Steel Blades Removable Bowls, 350W, 110-120V (Beige)
features: Powerful 350W Motor: The coffee grinder electric comes with a 350W motor and SUS 304 stainless steel blades. The strong motor also makes easy work of larger harder items, such as nuts, China seeds, and even nutmeg. Built-in overheat protection extends its lifespan.

3 Adjustable Grinding Modes: This electric spice grinder has 2 grinding speed levels and 1 pulse mode(P). You can grind ingredients on demand to suit your taste with a simple turn of the button. The pulse mode (P) help you precisely control the coarseness and fineness you want, effectively preserving the taste and aroma of your ingredients.

Easy to Use & Clean: The coffee bean grinder comes with a removable grinding bowl, which is made of 304 stainless steel. The spice grinder is an ideal gift for your friend who is coffee lover. Note: Only the bowl stainless steel is dishwasher-safe.

Multifunctional Wet & Dry grinder: The coffee grinder has a removable milling bowls. whether you're looking to blend up the whole spices or marinade, from delicate dried mint to fennel to peppercorn,this spice grinders is the best choice. If you're only planning to grind a teaspoon or so at a time, this coffe grinder also can feet you.

Leak-proof Cover & Measuring Spoon: Our electric coffee blade grinder bowls also have measurement on the inside, so you can easily add what you need without using separate measuring spoons. This grinder is degined with a rubber circle, which can keep ground ingredients from flying out as the blades spin.
